text:
Kuch baatein honthon tak aakar hi ruk gayi,
Kahin ankahi si woh chahat bikhar gayi.
Tujhe paane ki zidd toh nahi thi kabhi,
Bas tere bina har khushi adhuri lag gayi.
title: Ankahi Chahat
description: A soft and heartfelt poem about unspoken love and silent feelings that linger in the heart.
